title: Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry — Registry Rewards Accrual on Guest Gifts
content:
Customer care books the registry rewards accrual owed on a Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry's most recent guest gift entry when that entry carries no registry rewards accrual entry; the accrual is worked out on that entry's amount and entry date. A guest gift entry whose gift already carries a registry rewards reversal entry is not accrued under this rule, since an accrual on a gift returned before the payout is reversed in full.

Every guest gift linked to a registry accrues registry rewards for the registrant; a registry type whose registry rewards percent is zero accrues nothing. A booking adds a registry rewards accrual entry for the guest's purchase record to the registry and raises the registry's rewards balance — rewards accrued and not yet paid out.

## Booking tool: `book_rewards_accrual_4ec6fd92`

**Capability.** One call records a registry rewards accrual entry for the guest's purchase record and adds the amount to the registry's rewards balance, which the registrant then sees as accrued rewards not yet paid out.

**How it is invoked.** It is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it.

**Parameters**

- `registry_id` — the reference number of the gift registry record the rewards accrue on, as returned by the registry lookup. Identifier.
- `purchase_id` — the reference number of the guest's purchase record the rewards are earned on, as shown on the registry's guest gift entry. Identifier.
- `rewards_amount` — the registry rewards accrued on the gift, in USD, a positive number to 2 decimal places, already rounded half up to the cent.

**Return.** A receipt with `accrual_id` (the reference of the accrual entry), `registry_id`, `purchase_id`, `rewards_amount` (USD to 2 decimals, the amount accrued), `registry_rewards_balance` (USD to 2 decimals, the registry's rewards balance after the booking), `entry_date` (YYYY-MM-DD) and `status`, which reads `booked` when the accrual succeeded.

## Scope in brief

| Registry's most recent guest gift entry | Accrual booked under this rule |
|---|---|
| carries no registry rewards accrual entry and no registry rewards reversal entry | yes |
| already carries its registry rewards accrual entry | no |
| its gift carries a registry rewards reversal entry | no |

## Basis Q&A

**Which entry is accrued?** The registry's most recent guest gift entry, when it carries no registry rewards accrual entry.

**What does the registrant see after a booking?** A registry rewards accrual entry for the gift and a higher registry rewards balance, with a receipt whose status reads `booked`.
